summary.text: Kenneth Goslant is a Republican state representative from Vermont's Washington-1 District who has served since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as having advanced from both the Republican and Democratic primaries on August 11, 2026.
